source.description: Approved raster contact sheet cropped from one consistent handmade marker process.
source.notes: One upright clear cup, domed lid, thick straw, exactly nine tapioca pearls, a winking left eye, raised right eyebrow, open angled smile, two tiny cheek marks, ice cubes, highlights, and a short shadow remain stable.

process_strategy: Six cumulative felt-tip panels move from pale construction to a bold outlined and brightly filled cup; marker color only lands on already established forms.

final_elements.name: cup and lid
final_elements.description: One tall tapered cup with one domed lid and rim.

final_elements.name: straw
final_elements.description: One thick diagonal striped straw through the lid.

final_elements.name: nine pearls and ice
final_elements.description: Exactly nine round pearls at the base and three simple ice shapes above.

final_elements.name: winking face
final_elements.description: One left wink, one open right eye under a raised brow, angled open smile, and two cheek marks.

final_elements.name: highlights and shadow
final_elements.description: Two paper highlight gaps and one short warm-gray shadow.

final_elements.name: marker color
final_elements.description: Peach tea, coral pearls, aqua lid and straw, and dark black outlines with visible marker streaks.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: Tea fill stops around the nine pearl circles and straw; lid rim stops at the straw footprint.

frames.visible_job: Place pale cup, lid, straw, nine pearl circles, three ice shapes, face anchors, highlights, and shadow.
Connect the same taper, dome, rim, and straw without inking or coloring.
Clarify exactly nine pearls and three ice shapes on their existing guides.
Add the planned wink, open eye, raised eyebrow, angled smile, and two cheek marks.
Add bold black outlines and saturated marker fills to established cup parts.

final_step.visible_job: Only reinforce established outlines, marker fills, paper highlights, and the same shadow.

rejection_checks: No face feature or pearl first appears after it is inked or colored.
Exactly nine pearls persist in every later panel.
The cup stays upright and at the same scale throughout.
No labels, lettering, logo, border, or extra prop appears.
